name: staff_crystal
why: The mage's crystal staff (gearlook.js staffShape 'staff_crystal'), made by Tripo in place of the one procgear.js builds in code: the first Tripo piece for the equipment kit.

image.prompt: Stylized low-poly fantasy wizard staff, a single game prop shown whole, standing perfectly upright and vertical, centered, seen from the side. Gnarled dark wooden shaft with a wrapped leather grip a third of the way down and an iron cap at the foot. The top splits into three curling wooden prongs that cradle a large faceted violet crystal, bound with two thin gold bands. Chunky readable shapes, hand-painted flat colours with soft light-to-dark gradients, no texture noise, no harsh shadows. Game-ready prop in the style of KayKit adventurers. Plain light grey background, nothing else in the picture. --no hands, character, text, multiple objects
